segments.name: Metal and Minerals
segments.description: Holds a royalty on the NORI Property, a polymetallic nodule project in the CCZ, with no royalty revenue received yet.
segments.evidence: The Company had two reportable operating segments, Metal and Minerals and Oil and Gas.

segments.name: Oil and Gas
segments.description: Former gross overriding royalties on Colombian oil and gas blocks, classified as discontinued operations and spun out in 2025.
segments.evidence: The Oil and Gas segment is classified as discontinued operations effective September 2025 (see Note 15).

revenueModel.text: Royalty payments on metals produced from the NORI Property, paid by The Metals Company; none received to date.
revenueModel.evidence: To date, we have not received any royalty revenue from the NORI Royalty.

changes.text: The Oil and Gas business was classified as a discontinued operation in 2025.
changes.evidence: The Company met the criteria for classifying the Oil and Gas business as a discontinued operation as of September 30, 2025.

changes.text: The Oil and Gas business was spun out in 2025, ending the Company's interest in it.
changes.evidence: Upon completion of the Spin-Out on December 18, 2025, the Company ceased to have an interest in the Oil and Gas business.
